mostWorthwhile.text: Strengthening one synapse was most worthwhile: equal input, a larger local response and unchanged impulse height distinguish synaptic change from a bigger travelling signal.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding astrocytes was least informative: the resulting picture places them among the circuits but does not show their supporting role, although the initial item description hints at it.

surprise.text: The comparison showing inhibition keeping the same excitation below threshold clarified how inputs combine.

arbitrary.text: No action lacked a clear overall purpose, but the sequence offered only one combination at each step, so the choices felt prescribed rather than exploratory.

continue.text: I would continue: the synapse and voltage comparisons connect cellular structures to their functions, though I would want more explanation of how myelin speeds transmission.
